raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions contains 144 txn_ids that are delivered twice as exact copies, identical in every column including batch_id. silver_transactions does not dedupe, so 136 of them show up as duplicates among POSTED rows and inflate the gold counts and totals. Deduping on txn_id is safe because the copies are identical.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.93,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) AS rn FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') WHERE rn = 1;"}}
